columns.comment: Calendar date of the RM activity the note records. Today is 30-Sep-2026 (never use CURRENT_DATE); "last N days" means Date between DATE'2026-09-30' minus (N-1) days and DATE'2026-09-30'. Point-in-time measures ordered by Date return the last date of any longer period you group by.
columns.name: Date

columns.comment: Calendar month of the RM activity the note records as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01'. Point-in-time measures grouped by Month return the month's last date (month-end); the latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the RM activity the note records, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: True on the last calendar day of a month (the month-end snapshot date of the RM activity the note records).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics, Sunda Energi Nusantara). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match names with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'. About 380 groups.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) with its location, e.g. Kinokawa Precision (Singapore) Pte Ltd - "entity" or "subsidiary" means this level. About 2,500 entities; match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%Singapore%'.
columns.name: Client

columns.comment: Client segment: Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for APAC subsidiaries of Japanese groups (segment Japanese Corporate) - "Japanese corporates", "JC" or "Japanese clients" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Industry sector of the APAC taxonomy (e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy, Industrials); see Subsector.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Industry subsector within the sector (e.g. Semiconductors, Automotive Parts, Coal Mining, Shipping).
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: APAC booking location covering the client, ISO-2 code: SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand. "Country" means this unless the user says risk / HQ country.
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Primary relationship manager (fictional name) at the row's month-end: the CRM primary-RM assignment, else the group account-plan owner; null = no RM coverage.
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the primary RM sits - "RMs in Singapore / Hong Kong" means this (most RMs also cover clients booked in other countries, so it differs from Coverage Office).
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Internal rating grade 1-10 in force at the row's month-end (1 best, 10 default; 7 and worse is sub-investment watch territory); null = not rated (no credit relationship).
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: IFRS 9 stage at the row's month-end: 1 performing, 2 significant increase in credit risk, 3 credit-impaired / default; null = not rated.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when the client is on the credit watchlist at the row's month-end ("not on the watchlist" = false).
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating Low, Medium or High at the row's month-end (latest completed review); null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Final early-warning band at the row's month-end: Green (score < 40), Amber (40-69) or Red (>= 70), after overrides; null = not scored (no credit relationship, or before Apr-2025).
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Relationship manager who logged the activity and wrote the note (fictional name) - "by RM" in note questions means this; Primary RM is the client's covering RM.
columns.name: Note RM

columns.comment: Primary topic extracted from the note text: Credit & Liquidity, Pricing, Competition, Service Quality, Market & FX, Relationship, New Business or General.
columns.name: Note Topic

columns.comment: Sentiment of the note from its score: Negative (<= -0.2), Positive (>= 0.2) or Neutral.
columns.name: Sentiment Polarity

columns.comment: Label returned by Databricks ai_analyze_sentiment on the note text: Positive, Negative, Neutral or Mixed - stored beside the score label (D18 / D36).
columns.name: AI Sentiment Label

columns.comment: True when the note records a follow-up action for the RM.
columns.name: Action Required

columns.comment: Status of the follow-up action at 30-Sep-2026: Completed, Open or Overdue (null = no action).
columns.name: Action Status

columns.comment: RM call notes (CRM activities with a note) on the selected clients and days - a flow.
columns.name: Notes

columns.comment: Mean sentiment of the selected notes, -1 (very negative) to +1 (very positive).
columns.name: Average Note Sentiment

columns.comment: Notes with sentiment <= -0.2.
columns.name: Negative Notes

columns.comment: Notes with sentiment >= 0.2.
columns.name: Positive Notes

columns.comment: Negative notes / all notes (fraction).
columns.name: Negative Note Share %

columns.comment: Average news sentiment of each note's client group over the 90 days up to the note date (the external view at the time; notes without news are ignored).
columns.name: External News Sentiment

columns.comment: Average of note sentiment minus the group's 90-day news sentiment (positive = RMs more upbeat than the news; large positive values flag possible blind spots). Notes without news are ignored.
columns.name: Sentiment Divergence

columns.comment: Positive notes (>= 0.2) written while the group's news of the previous 90 days was negative (<= -0.2).
columns.name: Blind Spot Notes

columns.comment: Client groups whose external sentiment turned negative (last-90-day news average <= -0.2, prior 90 days not) while their RM notes stayed positive (last-90-day note average >= 0.2), as of 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Blind Spot Groups

columns.comment: Average news sentiment of the group over 3-Jul .. 30-Sep-2026 (a group status as of today; per group it is that group's value).
columns.name: Group News Sentiment Last 90D

columns.comment: Average RM-note sentiment of the group over 3-Jul .. 30-Sep-2026 (a group status as of today; per group it is that group's value).
columns.name: Group Note Sentiment Last 90D

columns.comment: Follow-up actions from the notes still Open or Overdue at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Actions Open

columns.comment: Follow-up actions past their due date and not completed at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: Actions Overdue

columns.comment: Share of notes where the ai_analyze_sentiment label equals the score label (Mixed never agrees) - about 64% overall.
columns.name: AI Label Agreement %

comment: Internal sentiment from RM call notes, Apr-2024 to Sep-2026: notes, average note sentiment -1..+1 (negative <= -0.2, positive >= 0.2), negative / positive notes, the client group's news sentiment around each note, internal-vs-external divergence, blind-spot notes and groups (news turned negative while RM notes stayed positive, as of 30-Sep-2026), follow-up actions open / overdue, and the agreement of the Databricks ai_analyze_sentiment label with the score label. Notes and actions add up over days; sentiment is an average. Grain: one row per RM call note / CRM activity (gold.fact_rm_note_sentiment).
